title: Junior Frontend Developer
description: Our Engineering team is growing and we are looking for a Junior Frontend Developer. You will measure and improve front-end performance, build accessible, responsive user interfaces and turn designs into reusable components. No professional experience needed; internships and personal projects count. You should be confident with Responsive Design, Web Accessibility, Redux, Vue.js, TypeScript and JavaScript. Experience with Playwright, GraphQL and CSS is a plus. Location: Remote (US/EU).
